user_query: I'm a developer working on an NFT marketplace and I need to integrate a news feed. Can you fetch the most recent NFT news and provide me with the headlines, descriptions, and source URLs? Also, suggest some popular NFT sources to include in the feed.

TaskList.description: Fetch the most recent NFT news articles including headlines, descriptions, and source URLs.
Identify and recommend popular NFT news sources to include in the feed.
